summary: Verified public DEMO travel APIs and desktop/mobile UI flows. Search works for all four services, trip persistence/share works, chat stream and suggestions work, and mobile has no horizontal overflow. Found one copy defect in the pinned-trip heading.

ui_bugs.issue: When exactly one result is pinned, heading says '1 saved picks' instead of '1 saved pick'.

action_items: Use singular grammar for one pinned trip item (saved pick).
critical_code_review_comments: Current travel provider and booking handoff are intentionally MOCKED/DEMO; ensure live Akbar integration remains behind a provider adapter and never presents a booking confirmation.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST Goa trip through /api/trips for persistence verification; no production seed data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested search services, DEMO labeling, chat stream/fallback, share persistence, pinning, voice capability handling, and mobile overflow were exercised. One low-priority copy issue remains.
rca of the issue: App.js renders `${selected.length} saved picks` for every nonzero count. Add a singular/plural expression when selected.length === 1.
